title: Heart model for represented open extension
statement: For a finite-field datum, a prime l distinct from p, an algebraic closure Ω, finite-type quasi-compact schemes X₀ and Y₀ over Spec(k₀), and an open immersion j₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀, there are a functor J from the ambient equivariant ind-heart over X₀ to that over Y₀ and an adjunction J ⊣ zlIndWeilPull such that every object represented by a common-stage Weil sheaf F is sent by J to an object represented by some common-stage Weil sheaf G.

source.document: SGA 4, exposé XVII, 5.1; Bhatt–Scholze, The pro-étale topology for schemes, 6.7.6–6.8.11
source.place: Exact extension by zero on the constructible heart and its normalized ind-extension.

proof.text: Extension by zero on the geometric constructible heart is exact and left adjoint to inverse image for an open immersion; finite type over the field gives the required noetherian and quasi-compact hypotheses.

Transport the heart functor through AsSmall and extend along the Yoneda Kan extension.  The normalized Frobenius mate and the Kan unit produce a functor J on equivariant ind-objects, an adjunction J ⊣ zlIndWeilPull, and a represented output for each represented input because the Kan unit is invertible on representables.
The construction includes empty and identity opens and the zero object by the same unit and counit formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem zlIndWeilOpenShriek_heart_model {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (j₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsOpenImmersion j₀.left] :
    ∃ J : zlIndWeilHeart D l hl Ω X₀ ⥤ zlIndWeilHeart D l hl Ω Y₀,
      Nonempty (J ⊣ zlIndWeilPull D l hl Ω j₀) ∧
        ∀ F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω,
          ∃ G : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl Y₀ Ω,
            Nonempty ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω Y₀).obj G ≅
              J.obj ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω X₀).obj F))
